```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown
import plotly.graph_objects as go

ROOT = Path.cwd()
while not (ROOT / "_quarto.yml").exists():
    ROOT = ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import chart_style as cs
import regulation_view as rv

ev, inst, log = rv.load()
n_ver = int((ev["status"] == "verified").sum())
n_dr = int((ev["status"] == "draft").sum())
```

```{python}
#| label: intro
Markdown(f"""
This is a dated list of **{len(ev)} milestones** in the Turkish electricity rulebook: the laws, the regulations under them,
board and presidential decisions, market launches and the new business types (storage, charging, aggregation).
Each entry names the institutions involved and links to the page it was read on.
**{n_ver} are verified** against a page that reproduces the official text or an official page; **{n_dr} are drafts**, taken from
the EPİAŞ handbook, a news item or inference, and are marked so. The chart shows verified entries only.

See the [legislation tree](tree.qmd) for how the instruments depend on each other,
[institutions](institutions.qmd) for who is responsible for what, and [method](method.qmd) for how this was researched and what was not read.
""")
```

::: {.callout-warning}
## Not legal advice, and not complete
This is a reading aid built from public pages. It lists milestones, not every amendment; dates are the dates shown on the pages
read. Check the official text (Resmî Gazete, mevzuat.gov.tr, EPDK) before relying on any entry.
:::

## Timeline

```{python}
#| label: chart
v = ev[ev["status"] == "verified"].copy()
areas = [a for a in rv.AREAS if a in set(v["area"])]
fig = cs.figure(None, None, height=470)
fig.update_layout(hovermode="closest", showlegend=False)
for a in areas:
    s = v[v["area"] == a]
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=s["when"], y=[a] * len(s), mode="markers", name=a,
        marker=dict(size=11, color=rv.AREA_COLOURS[a], line=dict(width=1, color=cs.SURF[cs.MODE]["surface"])),
        customdata=list(zip(s["date"], s["title"], s["kind"])),
        hovertemplate="%{customdata[0]}<br><b>%{customdata[1]}</b><br>%{customdata[2]}<extra></extra>",
    ))
fig.update_yaxes(categoryorder="array", categoryarray=areas[::-1], showgrid=True)
cs.show(fig)
```

## Download

```{python}
#| label: download
out = ev.drop(columns=["when"])
HTML(cs.download_link(out, "tr_power_lab_regulation_timeline.csv", "Timeline (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(inst, "tr_power_lab_institutions.csv", "Institutions (CSV)")
     + cs.download_link(log, "tr_power_lab_regulation_research_log.csv", "Research log (CSV)"))
```

Column `parent` links each entry to the instrument it rests on (it builds the tree); `status` is `verified` or `draft`.
